eyebrow: Git & GitHub for Software Engineers · Chapter 4, Lesson 18
subtitle: Where a workflow lives, and how to read a run

eyebrow: The whole setup is one file
code:
# .github/workflows/explore.yml
name: Explore GitHub Actions
on: [push]
jobs:
  explore:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Triggered by a push."
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
caption: on, jobs, steps — GitHub scans .github/workflows/ automatically, no registration step.
Committing a file to .github/workflows/ is the entire setup — no registration step.
Trigger, duration, and status — everything you need at a glance.
Where you actually debug a failure — the specific step, not the job as a whole.
